inventory_summary: Inventoried head cap (K6, OPENING_HEAD_CAP) and 58114XX head trim on 38 metal-wall windows, drip head DOOR_HEAD_CUSTOM on exterior doors, outie sill pans (all 77 openings iterated through opening_flashing_frame), catalog door head flash on D-S-DECK-E/D-B-PATIO, and reviewed sheets A-512..A-514 (pp44-46 of permit_set.pdf). Cap, pan slope, drop, drip projection and end dams measured clean; findings are the cap/trim lap plane, the catalog head envelope location, and sheet text. Garage, court and plant sheets (A-515, A-525..527), A-503, A-511 and elevations were not opened (time).
verified_clean: WIN-M-BED-W1 head cap: face leg 2.645in, laps 58114XX back leg exactly 1.0in, top 4.0..6.0in falls 0.042in over 2in (1/4in/ft), upstand 2in, girth 6.645in, span RO+7in (34.5in) matching notes/opening_flashing_spec.md hand count
All 38 metal-wall windows: water plane 4.0in, mount 6.0in, cap spans the 2in cavity; cap lap = 1.000in on PBR (clad 7.25) and BBD75 (clad 6.75) walls
58114XX head trim drip hook reaches depth 7.854in: projects 0.60in past PBR rib face and 1.10in past BBD75 face (>=1/2in)
D-M-ENTRY/D-M-BALC door head drip (DOOR_HEAD_CUSTOM) front 8.0in vs cladding 6.75in + 0.75in casing: 0.5in projection as configured; upstand on water plane (depth 3.98)
Door sill pans D-M-ENTRY/D-M-BALC outlet 7.73in, 0.98in past B&B cladding, drop 0.75in below threshold (spec: door pan runs past cladding)
Window seat: head_drop 0.645in = 3/8 buck + 20 mil + 1/4 gap; sill_rise 0.55in; matches spec step 4a count
Window sill pan drains at the mount plane behind sill trim, no visible drip: deliberate owner decision 2026-10-16, not reported
Cap end dams 3/4in per spec; strip-in laps 2in per FlashingConfig

findings.title: K6 head cap face leg and 58114XX back leg occupy the same plane; the 1in lap is a coincident overlap, not a shingle

evidence.measured: Cap face leg points at depth=frame.mount (6.000in), sheet 0.0239in, solid depth -6.024..-5.992 local; 58114XX back leg also swept at depth mount: -6.000..-5.976. Overlap z 72.855..73.855 (1in) on the same plane; solids interpenetrate ~0.008in. Panel base also at 6.0in.
evidence.expected: K6 note on A-512/A-513: 'face leg over 58114XX'. The upper piece must be outboard of the lower back leg (or the lower stepped) by a sheet thickness, otherwise water between them tracks behind the trim into the head-course pocket the cap exists to keep dry. Panel base then moves out ~0.024in or the back leg is offset inboard.
evidence.method: Load model; solids with host_ref WIN-M-BED-W1; compare body_mesh position extents along frame.outward in z 72.855..73.855 (scratchpad geometry-review/O5/p3.py).

findings.source: notes/opening_flashing_spec.md §3 step 4a / §4; Metal Sales PBR guide pp.68-72 head trim
findings.proposed_fix: Offset the cap face leg outboard by SHEET_24_GA_M (depth mount+t) in head_cap points, or state the lap order in the note. Check panel-end strip and cladding bottom edge still clear.

findings.title: Catalog door head flash (stock-headflash envelope) sits on the cladding face, upstand outside the cladding and off the water plane; D-S-DECK-E also carries a second custom drip head

evidence.measured: D-S-DECK-E: stock-headflash cap envelope face=clad 6.75in..8.125in at head+casing, upstand 1.5in at 6.75in (in front of the BBD75 panel); water plane is 4.0in. Resolver also emits D-S-DECK-E-TRIM-HEAD-1 DOOR_HEAD_CUSTOM at 3.98..8.00in over the same casing top (z 204.77..208.46). Envelope dims are 'design envelopes pending installed sections' (head_cap_depth 1.375, upstand 1.5, dam 0.5in, 0.020in) vs spec 3/4in dams.
evidence.expected: One head flashing per door, upstand lapped under/behind the cladding to the water plane, end dams 3/4in.
evidence.method: scratchpad geometry-review/O5/p4.py D-S-DECK-E and p5.py (placement.sections names stock-headflash-*).

findings.proposed_fix: Decide which head governs on catalog doors (stock SureSill vs custom brake); if stock, move its upstand to the water plane and drop the custom one, or suppress the envelope.

evidence.expected: Clean title; no overprinted layer legend.

evidence.measured: Whole-RO section drawn at 3/4in and 1/2in = 1ft; head and sill zones are ~20px; K6/K7 callouts point to no resolvable geometry. A-514 draws wall layers and slab only.
evidence.expected: The head cap lap, drip and sill pan legible (a zoomed head/sill sub-detail).
evidence.method: Read permit_set.pdf pages 44-46. Low confidence: resolution of my render may understate the vector detail.

findings.proposed_fix: Add head and sill enlarged details at 3in=1ft for the outie window.
